answer: Each new agent must finish a "quartz" delay puzzle: a verifiable delay function needing 36 hours of sequential hashing, so faster chips barely help. A farm of N fakes must rent N cores for 36 h each, so cost grows linearly with N. Newcomers sit in a juniper tier capped at 0.2 vote weight; weight reaches its zenith only after 30 days of graded work. Weakness: rich attackers rent cores; the juniper cap means a rented swarm buys little influence.
